title: Jagex Patched the Raid Skip… So I Broke it Again
author: CrossRSDW
description:
Original Kuldra skip discovery: [Tiger with the Bars] — original video linked here: [https://youtu.be/2Zn04m-mq80]

Jagex patched the previous raid skip, so I broke it all over again. You can skip two zones, skip the jump puzzle (more consistently), and even skip the entire final boss encounter.

I'm CrossRSDW, and I spent time stress-testing the raid so you don't have to. I've found cheese, tricks, and skips that will speed up your farming runs.

Hope to see you in Ashenfall o7

0:00 Intro
0:48 Dragontail Vines Skip
1:43 Updated Jump Puzzle Skip
2:21 Shattered Stronghold Skip
3:58 Kuldra Skip

transcript.text: New tech has been discovered in the culture raid. So today I'm going to be showing you how to get through the
culture raid fast, super fast, sub 20 minutes fast. They patched the teleport exploit, so this is the new fastest
version. Thanks to some community research, there's even a skip for the boss herself. By the time you reach the
end game for Dragon Wilds, you really only need two resources. You need all of the drops off of the culture drop table,
and you need ascension shards for tier eight. You are going to need a lot of ascension shards for tier eight.
Ascension shards are only located from two sources. They're guaranteed drop from each of the three black dragons,
and they're a possible drop from any of the chests inside the raid. This run optimizes your ability to farm ascension
shards. After you've killed the black dragon and collected the chest, there's another chest located immediately
beneath your feet on the vines. To do the first major skip of the raid, we're going to wind step back up to the black
dragon heap, and we're going to jump around behind it. From here, you can wind step jump in between the two ash
trees. This skips the island in the sky with the undead. Then we kill the next black dragon.
We can safe spot him from this wall. I collect the earth buff here and open the door.
Because our next chest is located just inside. We complete the rest totally normal.
We're going to grab the chest at the top of the fire tower. And we're going to grab the next chest
atop the wall next to the air skeletons. There's another chest around the corner here.
I found a more consistent method for skipping the jump puzzle. I still recommend immediately killing the
necromancer because he can spawn skeletons on the red platform. My new method involves a combination of surge,
double jump, and phase dash. It's much harder to fail and fall this way. After we cast surge and phase dash, surge off
the edge of the platform and then immediately double jump and then immediately double dash. If you time
everything appropriately, you will land on the exit platform. Congrats, you have skipped the entire jump puzzle. We're
going to grab the two chests here. I head up to the teleporter to reset the
abyssal demons aggro. The next major cheese is a huge development. I suspected it was possible and recently
discovered the tech to do so. First, we're going to hug the castle on the right hand side. We're going to wind
step our way around to the back of the castle. You're going to see some geometry sticking out of the wall here in this
corner. And we're going to wind step onto that. And then from here, we're going to wind
step onto the outermost portion of the broken wall. From here, we're going to jump up to the
very top of this broken wall. There's an invisible ceiling above us. So, when the camera pulls in tight, you
know you're at the very top. From here, we're going to do the same surge plus phase dash combination. Turn your
character to point towards the next zone. Surge, double jump, and double wind dash
your way to the next location, thus skipping both doors and all of the mechanic. You can kill the black dragon
here however you like. There's another chest on the left side. We complete the jump puzzle normally.
grabbing the chest on the right hand side at the end.
We can sneak past most of these guardians, triggering only the ranger by hugging the rightmost wall.
And then we complete these puzzles normally. Before the culter fight, there are two
chests, one on the right hand side in a broken tower.
>> And then another on the left side underneath an overhang. And now for the big cheese.
You can actually skip the entire Coldarra fight itself. Shortly after posting my last video, I found a path
which allows a player to travel from the phase one platform all the way to the phase three platform. Wind step from the
highest point of this platform, which is the far left side, and you will easily clear it onto this leftmost brick.
You'll see another floating brick straight ahead. Quick wind step will get you there.
And then it is another quick wind step all the way to the phase three platform. A special thanks to Tiger with the bars.
I've got a link to his original video in the description. The original version uses wind step. If you're not careful,
you can easily die. I use the same surge and phase dash combination as we used earlier. You can see I mess up messes up
the first time. Stand at the edge of this platform and surge forward. Then immediately double jump and then
immediately follow that up with your double wind dash. And then there's the Coldarra exit. And now you're at
Coldarra's heart. Cuz apparently it's available right there. Congrats. Once you shoot the
heart a bunch of times, you can then walk out and it is done. You have just completed the raid without needing to do
almost any of the mechanics. You'll have to complete the raid approximately 24 times on average in order to get every
drop at least once from her loot table. If you're doing it in about 20 minutes per run, that'll take you around 8 hours
total. That's not too bad by OSRS or RS3 standards. And that's it. This was fun to put together. Thanks for watching.
I'll talk to you soon.

comments.author: @CrossRSDW
comments.text:
Still working as of 07/OCT/2026 [Patch 1.0.0.7]:
- All skips featured are still working on PC.
- IF YOU HIT AN INVISIBLE BARRIER during the Kuldra skip, YOU ARE TOO HIGH. Let yourself fall slightly before using your second Wind Dash. You can see this small drop in the video before the second dash.
- IF YOU DIE DURING THE WINDSTEP method for Kuldra (see the original credited video in the description), YOU ARE TOO FAR FORWARD ON THE GREEN CRYSTALS. There is an insta-kill barrier if you move too far forward/down. This is why I prefer the Surge/Phase Dash method shown in the video—it has been faster and safer in my testing.

Two skips worth mentioning.
1. Jumping puzzle with skeletons has a faster skip. Right as you go through the gate, in the far left corner of the room is a hole in the wall, wind step up to it, crouch through it, drop down, and run along the wall to the end.
2. you can skip the final puzzle before the boss. As you're running along the pipes to the fire puzzle, the end of the right wall and the rocks is a big hole in the wall, jump through it and wind step onto the roof of the puzzle, then run along the geometry to the waypoint. Then either home TP, unstuck TP, or find a place to clip back through the floor.

​ @rampancyyy6569  Hello! :)
Surge is the spell that replaces your dodge-roll, and phase-dash gives you a second mid-air dash.

On X-Box, it would be 'B', 'A',  'B + B'.
- Surge off cliff (B)
- Jump at end of surge (A)
- Air-dash twice after jump (B + B)
